title: Post-Operative Treatment With Ketorolac After Abdominal Myomectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if ketorolac, given after abdominal myomectomy, will decrease the frequency of post-oerative fevers as well as improve post-operative pain management.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ant patient undregoing abdominal myomectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with contraindication to NSAIDs including history of peptic ulcer disease, renal disease, bleeding diathesis, or hypersensitivity to NSAIDS
